issues.description: Fresh extraction hard-requires data/stories/manifest.json and story files that are not present in the repo.
The advertised demo fails on a clean output path because the first extract command depends on missing source data.
The end-to-end test currently fails from this checkout because it assumes unavailable story fixtures.
Vector artifacts are loaded without schema, shape, layer, backend, or model compatibility validation.
Preference steering trusts manifest and vector shapes blindly, producing raw IndexError or invalid results for mismatched artifacts.
Config values are coerced but never validated, so empty emotions, negative counts, bad thresholds, or invalid fractions fail late.
stories_dir is resolved relative to the process working directory instead of the config file location.
HF residual extraction tokenizes without truncation or max-length handling, so long stories can exceed the model context window.
When tokenizer offsets are unavailable or matching fails, steering falls back to every prompt token instead of only activity tokens.
Preference logits compare only the first token of ' good' and ' bad', making scoring tokenizer-dependent and possibly wrong.
The configured min_reported_emotions value is ignored and the steering report is hardcoded to four emotions.
A PCA variance threshold of 0 is accepted but still returns one component, so neutral projection cannot be disabled cleanly.
The documented tiny demo commands are not reproducible from a clean checkout because required story inputs are missing.
